dashboard.label: P7 — Phishing Email Investigation & Security Operations
dashboard.description: Operational SOC Dashboard: Email security gateway telemetry, suspicious sender analysis, malicious attachment and URL triage, authentication failures, and incident correlation.

search.query: index=email sourcetype="email:security" attachment_name!="none" | eval is_dangerous=if(match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|vbs|xlsm|docm|iso|pdf\.exe)$"), 1, 0) | where is_dangerous=1 | stats count
index=email sourcetype="email:security" url!="none" | eval is_bad_url=if(match(url, "^http://\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|(?i)(login|signin|auth|verify|portal|bit\.ly)"), 1, 0) | where is_bad_url=1 | stats count
index=email sourcetype="email:security" (spf="fail" OR dkim="fail" OR dmarc="fail") | stats count

chart.title: Phishing Attack Vector & Lure Category Distribution

search.query: index=email sourcetype="email:security" risk_score>=75 | eval category=case( attachment_name!="none" AND match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|vbs|xlsm|iso|pdf\.exe)"), "Weaponized Attachment", match(url, "^http://\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|(?i)(login|signin|auth|verify)"), "Credential Harvester / Link", match(sender, "(?i)(ceo|cfo|executive)"), "Executive Impersonation / Whaling", spf="fail" AND dmarc="fail", "Domain Spoofing / Auth Failure", true(), "General Phishing Lure" ) | stats count by category

chart.title: Email Security Enforcement Actions (Delivered vs Quarantined vs Blocked)

search.query: index=email sourcetype="email:security" | stats count by action

index=email sourcetype="email:security" | eval auth_status=case( spf="pass" AND dkim="pass" AND dmarc="pass", "Full Alignment (Pass)", spf="fail" AND dmarc="fail", "Critical Spoof (SPF+DMARC Fail)", spf="fail" OR dkim="fail", "Partial Failure", true(), "Unauthenticated" ) | stats count by auth_status

index=email sourcetype="email:security" risk_score>=75 | eval Threat_Type=case( match(attachment_name, "\.(exe|vbs|xlsm|iso|pdf\.exe)$"), "Weaponized Attachment (T1566.001)", match(url, "^http://\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|(?i)(login|signin|auth|verify)"), "Credential Harvester (T1566.002)", match(sender, "(?i)(ceo|cfo|executive)"), "Executive Impersonation / Whaling", spf="fail" AND dmarc="fail", "Domain Spoofing / Auth Failure", true(), "Suspicious Message" ) | table timestamp, sender, recipient, subject, Threat_Type, action, risk_score | rename timestamp as "Timestamp", sender as "Sender Address", recipient as "Target Recipient", subject as "Email Subject", Threat_Type as "Threat Classification", action as "Enforcement", risk_score as "Risk Score" | sort - "Risk Score"

index=email sourcetype="email:security" attachment_name!="none" | eval is_threat=if(match(attachment_name, "(?i)\.(exe|vbs|xlsm|iso|pdf\.exe)"), 1, 0) | where is_threat=1 | table timestamp, attachment_name, attachment_size_kb, attachment_hash, sender, recipient, action | rename timestamp as "Timestamp", attachment_name as "File Name", attachment_size_kb as "Size (KB)", attachment_hash as "SHA-256 Hash", sender as "Sender", recipient as "Recipient", action as "Action"

index=email sourcetype="email:security" url!="none" | eval is_threat=if(match(url, "^http://\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|(?i)(login|signin|auth|verify|bit\.ly)"), 1, 0) | where is_threat=1 | table timestamp, url, sender, recipient, action, risk_score | rename timestamp as "Timestamp", url as "Extracted URL", sender as "Sender", recipient as "Target Recipient", action as "Action", risk_score as "Risk Score"
